name: ai-agent-bootstrap
title: AI Agent Bootstrap Feature
description: Core feature for bootstrapping AI agents with context, tools, and memory

requirements: Agent must initialize with valid context from spec://context/default@1.0.0
Agent must register available tools from MCP registry
Agent must validate credentials before first API call
Agent must support hot-reload of configuration
acceptance_criteria: All registered tools are accessible via spec:// URIs
Memory layer responds to queries within 100ms p95
implementation_notes: Use lazy loading for tool registration
Implement circuit breaker for external API calls
test_strategy: Unit tests for each initialization step
Integration tests with mock MCP servers
E2E tests with full agent lifecycle

metadata.rollback_plan: Revert to previous agent version via versioned specs
